about: Example meals that bring together foods from the evidence levers. Amounts are added up by the app from CoFID 2021. They are examples of how a meal can contain a nutrient, never the best meal for anyone, and never a diet plan.

meals.name: Lentil salad with red pepper and orange
meals.description: Plant iron from lentils, with vitamin C from pepper and orange in the same meal, which helps the body absorb that kind of iron.

meals.name: Rump steak with broccoli, red pepper and rice
meals.description: Haem iron from red meat, which the body absorbs more easily than plant iron, with vegetables rich in vitamin C.

meals.name: Grilled mackerel with new potatoes and spinach
meals.description: Oily fish is one of the few foods with a useful amount of vitamin D, and it brings the omega-3 fats EPA and DHA.

meals.name: Sardines on wholemeal toast with tomatoes
meals.description: Tinned sardines bring vitamin B12 and vitamin D, and their soft bones add calcium.

meals.name: Boiled eggs, wholemeal toast and a glass of milk
meals.description: Eggs and milk are common sources of vitamin B12 for people who eat animal foods but not much meat.

meals.name: Kidney bean, chickpea and spinach stew
meals.description: Beans, chickpeas and leafy greens are among the richest food sources of folate.

meals.name: Porridge with blueberries and walnuts
meals.description: Oats bring beta-glucan, the soluble fibre shown to lower LDL cholesterol when eaten regularly.
